slotPartition._measured_2026-08-14: *** THE PARTITION IS STILL UNRESOLVED AND IS STILL NOT RESOLVED HERE. What changed is that the CONSEQUENCES are now measured rather than predicted. *** Four facts, from running `harness-run --generate-only` against this file and against scratch variants of it - none of them a binding decision, and none of them taken:
slotPartition._measured1: (a) THIS FILE NOW GENERATES A COPY LAYER; IT DID NOT BEFORE, AT ANY SLOT COUNT. `SLOT-HBA-ALL` was refused outright - `slot id 'SLOT-HBA-ALL' is not a plain identifier, and it is part of every generated tag name` - because the generator required the slot id to be legal inside a PLC tag name. The id is also the only join to a vector's `slot` field, and set B's ids carry hyphens too, so the requirement was unsatisfiable from both ends. The generator now keeps the id as the key and transliterates it for the tag fragment (`HX_SLOT_HBA_ALL_Start`), reporting the derivation per slot. No id in this file changed.
slotPartition._measured2: (b) SIX SLOTS AS THE PROSE DESCRIBES THEM ARE NOW REFUSED BY NAME, AND WERE PREVIOUSLY EMITTED SILENTLY. md:179-181 says all six drive the SAME instance and the SAME members. A copy layer for six such slots emits six writers of every stimulus member and six writers of `.Stim.Start`; rungs run in order every scan, so the LAST slot owns the block and the other five drive nothing - measured on a two-slot equivalent, which compiled, deployed and returned a package per slot. The generator now refuses it, naming all eleven shared destinations and the two routes md:187-189 already gives: six instances (a project-shape decision), or ONE slot per wave set run in sequence.
slotPartition._measured3: (c) SHARING THE OBSERVATIONS IS FINE AND IS ADMITTED. The eight `resultSources` here are READ by the copy layer, and each slot writes them into its own register band, so any number of slots may observe them. That is now counted and reported rather than silently absorbed. The write direction is the only one that collides.
slotPartition._measured4: (d) WIDTH, MEASURED FROM THE EMITTED LAYER RATHER THAN FROM THE DESIGN. This file as committed: 32 registers (control 6, vectors 18, results 8, 0 latches). With the two block outputs declared transient+rearming, as set B's map._capabilityRequest asks: 34 (results 10, 2 latches). Six slots each driving their own stimulus instance: 162 (vectors 108, results 48); with the same two latches per slot, 174. *** THE DEPLOYED MIRROR IS 35 REGISTERS AND THE AREA POINTER IS `P#M1000.0 WORD 35`, SO THE SIX-SLOT FORMS ARE 4.6x AND 5x THE POINTER AND WOULD CHANGE THE DEPLOY. *** One slot fits either way.
slotPartition._stillOwedFromTheCoordinator: The partition itself. The prose states no slot column, and nothing above supplies one. Until it is stated, `harness-run` stops before deploying with `27 vector(s) name 6 slot(s) that no binding declares` - which is the honest position and costs nothing.
